note: Starter outlet list for Page 2. Bias labels are Jay's hand-curated judgments to review and edit. Every feedURL below was fetched and returned a valid RSS or Atom document at seed time. Edit the note field freely. See excludedNote for outlets whose public feeds are dead or blocked.
excludedNote: Reuters, Associated Press, Newsmax, and Politico were left out: Reuters and Newsmax public feeds did not respond, AP and Politico returned HTTP 403 to a plain client. Add them later if you find a working feed.
